s: Minhag yapeh leqatztzer bitpillat shacharit ubo b' seipim: tob shello lehaarik bitpillat shacharit, kede lemaher beinyan sheyyukal lehitpallel musap qodem v' shaot umechetza. Veim heerik hachazzan yoter midday, vei epshar shello yeacharu musap ad leachar v' shaot umechetza — yesh ledalleg selichot ve"abinu malkenu" kede lehatchil tepillat musap qodem sheyyaggia zeman tepillat hammincha, dehaynu v' shaot umechetza, sheaz min haddin tzarik lehitpallel mincha techilla kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"v. Umikkol maqom im era sheecharu lehitpallel musap ad v' shaot umechetza — ap al pi ken yitpalelu musap techilla qodem mincha, mittaam shennitbaer sham, ayyen sham:
Tob lomar meat selichot benachat meharbeh bimrutza:
